description: This file defines the 'Question' entity class for use with JPA/Hibernate in a Java application, representing a question object with fields like id, title, and description, along with database mapping annotations.

classes.name: Question
classes.description: Entity class representing a question with id, title, and description, mapped to the 'questions' table in the database.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the question.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the identifier of the question.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Returns the title of the question.

methods.name: setTitle
methods.description: Sets the title of the question.

methods.name: getDescription
